idleSub: Yendani pa bwalo lililonse kuti mudziwe chomwe chili. Zimatenga masekondi pafupifupi 20.
pausedSub: Dinani kapena kanikizani Enter kuti mupitirize.
emptySub: Onjezani zina m'masewerawa kuti athe kuseweredwa.
copyFail: Mawuwo asankhidwa. Wakopereni ndi Ctrl kapena Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Masewera a mapu a malingaliro. Yendetsani munthuyo ku lingaliro lililonse.
stageHow: Yendani ndi mivi kapena W A S D. Kanikizani N kuti mupite ku lingaliro lotsatira. Kanikizani Escape kuti muyimitse. Kanikizani Tab kuti mupitirize. Mawu onse alinso pansi pa Werengani popanda kusewera.
hintKeys: Mivi kapena WASD poyenda. N kwa lingaliro lotsatira.
hintTouch: Gwirani mapu kapena gwiritsani ntchito mabatani
guideText: Lowani pa bwalo lowala kuti mudziwe chomwe chili. Bwalo lililonse lomwe mwakhudza limalowa pa mapu.
